method: DB before/after + sweep SQL recorded as ORM shapes verbatim from source (no live DB on this runner: full boot needs Postgres + app registry; SQL below is compiler-form, rows are shape-derived per the assistant-fixture precedent). Pure branches (local_runner fields, error-code truncation, event-cap arithmetic) mirror executed vectors from FX-DISP-01/04/05.

cloud_guards_in_order: enforce_creation_rate(workspace_id, actor_id, automatic); manual re-raises, automatic captures {code, detail}
atomic: lock Workspace row; count QUEUED cloud runs; >= CLOUD_AGENT_MAX_QUEUED_PER_WORKSPACE -> quota error (raise or capture)
managed_branches: automatic and transient (NOT_CONNECTED + enrolled exists) -> pinned to latest-heartbeat enrolled + error_code desktop_not_connected

managed_refusal_detail.managed_runner_disabled: Pi Dash Agent is not enabled on this instance.
managed_refusal_detail.desktop_not_connected: Open the Pi Dash desktop app on the machine you want this to run on.
managed_refusal_detail.llm_config_missing: The run creator has no AI provider configured. Configure one in Pi Dash AI settings.
managed_refusal_detail.gateway_scopes_missing: Sign in to Pi Dash again to refresh your AI access.
managed_refusal_detail.byok_not_supported_on_desktop: Pi Dash Agent on desktop uses OpenHub. Switch your AI provider to OpenHub to run here; Pi Dash AI and the Cloud Agent keep using your own key.
managed_refusal_detail.no_managed_runner_for_project: This project has no Pi Dash Agent on your desktop yet.

lock_cloud_creation_capacity.shape: lock Workspace row; count QUEUED; over cap -> automatic returns {code, detail}, manual raises CloudAgentAdmissionError(run_quota_exceeded)

dispatch_waiting.shape: lock workspace; running=count(RUNNING); offered=count(QUEUED with lease in future); capacity=max(0, MAX_RUNNING-running-offered); oldest QUEUED unlocked/expired rows up to capacity, ordered by created_at; set lease_expires_at=now+LEASE_SECONDS, dispatch_attempts+1; on_commit publish -> run_cloud_agent.delay per id
sql_sketches: SELECT ... FROM "agent_run" WHERE executor_kind=%s AND workspace_id=%s AND status=%s FOR UPDATE; -- workspace lock
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "agent_run" WHERE executor_kind=%s AND workspace_id=%s AND status='running';
SELECT ... FROM "agent_run" WHERE status='queued' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= now) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT %s FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
UPDATE "agent_run" SET lease_expires_at=%s, dispatch_attempts=dispatch_attempts+1 WHERE id=%s AND status='queued';

dispatch_agent_run.shape: only(id,status,executor_kind,pod_id,workspace_id) get; missing or not QUEUED -> return; cloud -> dispatch_waiting(workspace_id); else runner.services.matcher.drain_pod_by_id(pod_id)

events_append.shape: atomic: lock AgentRun row; count events; limit=CLOUD_AGENT_MAX_EVENTS; count >= limit-2 -> maybe insert events_truncated marker (if count < limit-1 and none exists), return False; else seq=max+1, create(kind[:64], payload), return True
events_append.reserved_rows: 1 terminal + 1 truncation marker inside the configured maximum
